remarks:
Room to Roam !  21 + acres of country living. The original home was built in 1960.  The last owner started remodeling in 2017. There are many newer features in the home. There is work to be completed.  A lot of materials for the projects are in the house and may remain. Currently a 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom ranch. There is a set up for a 1/2 bathroom, needs to be fully completed. Kitchen cabinets in place but needs counter tops put in and finishing work done.  Some flooring needs to be installed.  
First floor laundry room. Newer siding, roof, concrete front porch and rear patio. Granite countertops in bathrooms. Newer garage door. Prodigy siding.  Some newer Marvin Integrity windows and doors.    Condenser needed for a/c. There is an inground pool, barn and pond on the property. 
Great Opportunity for the right buyer.  This property is being sold in " as is " condition.  This is a " Cash Only Sale ".  The square footage of the house is larger than public records show.  Professionally measured by an appraiser.  ** The previous owner was in the process of remodeling the house.
